title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Japanese Derby has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even Maruzensky can't hide her unease as the echoing cheers of the spectators welcome her onto the course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She steels her nerves and heads to the track, ready to enjoy the greatest race in Japan.
